findings.problem: Both payloads retain three bare numbered-pointer RAW_TEXT aliases and preferred labels without JCM qualification. Actual JCM403 separates vitamin, B12 and thiamine stocks. A providerless number does not identify a global preparation; native is_resolving_synonym returns True for all six aliases. Earlier ivm-01 fixed citation attribution, not this boundary.
findings.proposed_bounded_fix: Qualify preferred terms with JCM and preparation identity; preserve exact old pointer strings and all source provenance as REJECTED_LABEL; retain source occurrence routing and append history. Re-review exact successor and all backlinks; do not resolve generic pointers by label alone.

findings.title: Interpreted mineral-base supernatant composition labeled recipe transcription
findings.problem: The primary NBRC1356 recipe is a charged-solids preparation followed by precipitation and supernatant use. The payload asserts only retained water, correctly declining retained salt amounts, but labels this inferred component list RECIPE_TRANSCRIPTION. It is not a literal transcription of the source ingredient list.
findings.proposed_bounded_fix: Use CURATED_INTERPRETATION for the water-retention inference with explicit rationale and unmeasured retained-salt limits, or omit the derived has-part list until supported. Preserve all charge recipe facts in provenance and do not convert them into retained concentrations. Ground the water component if retained.

findings.title: Feasible component references left unmapped alongside genuine form limits
findings.problem: Multiple complete stock payloads leave every component UNMAPPED, including source-explicit constituents with compatible verified frozen catalog identities. Most direct counterexample: NBRC1321 explicitly names cyanocobalamin and distilled water, while CHEBI17439 and CHEBI15377 baseline owners exist. Nicotinic acid, riboflavin and p-aminobenzoic acid likewise have compatible baseline entities. Unknown generic B12, DL/D pantothenate, salt hydration and nested stock identities are different scientific questions.
findings.proposed_bounded_fix: Finish bounded per-component catalog/ontology grounding using exact source form and preserve evidence. Resolve only verified compatible entities, retaining UNMAPPED with a precise missing fact for genuine form ambiguity. Do not infer cyanocobalamin from generic B12 or D-pantothenate from unspecified/DL text; do not merge duplicate physical catalog rows merely to use their entity CURIE.

findings.title: New agent-authored evidence uses human-review evidence type
findings.problem: The new/changed ontology_mapping.evidence entries use MANUAL_CURATION, whose native EvidenceTypeEnum explicitly means evidence supplied by a human reviewer. Histories identify worker08 agent processes and llm_assisted:true; supplied peer reviews are separate in-process agents, not human identity witnesses. Identical inherited evidence is excluded from this finding.
findings.proposed_bounded_fix: Retype each newly authored evidence entry to the source/decision type actually supported (for example DATABASE_MATCH or CURATOR_JUDGMENT as applicable), retaining exact sources and honest LLM assistance. Do not silently claim human verification. This is provenance correction, not chemical invalidation.

findings.title: Component completeness conflates unknown formulation with explicit omission
findings.problem: PARTIAL is defined by the schema as source-explicit additional constituents omitted; UNKNOWN means the source does not establish list completeness. Several selected stocks say carrier/additional constituents are unspecified, while PCR-S11 Na2HPO4 uses exact-form uncertainty despite listing source salt and water. Those explanations do not by themselves prove explicit omission.
findings.proposed_bounded_fix: Audit completeness per cited source. Use UNKNOWN when composition closure is unsettled, COMPLETE only when source closes the list, and PARTIAL only with an explicit omitted-constituent basis. Keep hydrate grounding, missing solvent quantity, and unknown formulation closure as separate facts. No invented constituents are requested.

Keep occurrence-specific source corrections separate and append bounded history. Do not normalize a malformed formula into a universal chemical identity.
